klge01.title: Leo.exe: How Are You, Really?
klge01.caption:
"Thriving!!" is easier to type than "honestly, tired."
You don't have to perform for the people who love you. Let one of them see the unpolished version this week.

klge02.title: Virgo.exe: Draft 14
klge02.caption:
Fourteen drafts for a two-word reply.
The first honest version is usually the kind one. Send it before the footnotes start. Save this for your next "sounds fun!"

klge03.title: Scorpio.exe: One Dry Text
klge03.caption:
One "ok" and the worst-case story writes itself.
When a text feels cold, ask before you go quiet. Most of the time they were just driving.

klge04.title: Gemini.exe: Subject Changed
klge04.caption:
"Can we talk about us?" and suddenly there's a dog video.
When it gets real, stay in the hard sentence one line longer. That's where the closeness is.
